title: ortachne tenuis
intro: Ortachne tenuis, commonly known as the slender grass or Australian windmill grass, is a type of perennial grass native to Australia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory conditions such as asthma. The therapeutic actions of Ortachne tenuis include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Ortachne tenuis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
